messages:
Ana (partnerships): Quick sync — AWS private offer structure for Q3 renewals. I want to propose a slabed discount tied to committed spend + an early renewal credit. Thoughts? :thinking:
Tom (sales): I'm in favor of slabs. customers respond well to clear breakpoints. Can we keep the top tier >$500k?
Priya (rev-ops): Need to model impact on ARR recognition. Slabs + one-time credits can distort quarter. Let's have a simple rule: credit applies only if renewal signed >30 days before expiry.
Marta (legal): Also need a clause for marketplace private offers that prevents stacking with other promo codes. AWS will require explicit private offer paperwork — include template.
Liam (finance): Ran quick calc — if we do 5/10/15% tiers at 100k/300k/600k, and a 5% early renewal credit (applied as account balance), NPV looks OK for 12–24 month terms. But we should cap total discount at 20%.
Tom (sales): Can we see a concrete example to sell to AE? a short cheat-sheet.
Ana (partnerships): Sure — proposed cheat-sheet (copyable for AEs):
```
Tier A: 100k-299k => 5% off list + 1% early renewal credit
Tier B: 300k-599k => 10% off list + 3% early renewal credit
Tier C: 600k+   => 15% off list + 5% early renewal credit (max combined discount 20%)
Notes: min 12-month commitment, private-offer paperwork required, credit applies to next invoice, cannot combine with marketplace promo codes.
```
Priya (rev-ops): Add: minimum billing velocity clause (30 days) and a 60-day clawback window if customer cancels early.
Marta (legal): I'll add the non-stacking language and a short IP/data residency sentence for customers requesting dedicated/private deployments.
Tom (sales): Also recommend a renewal play: if customer signs 45–90 days before expiry offer a one-time onboarding credit (not stackable with early renewal credit). Keep it simple though.
Liam (finance): Agree on onboarding credit but make it a fixed $ amount for predictability (e.g., $10k for mid-market, $25k for enterprise).
Ana (partnerships): Okay, next steps: Marta to draft private-offer addendum + non-stack clause; Priya to update rev model with clawback; Liam to finalize cap and onboarding credit numbers; Tom to prepare AE cheat-sheet with the tiers. I'll circle back with AWS PM to confirm private-offer paperwork flow.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing flagged: please attach the approved private-offer template to the product listing once legal signs off. <https://redwood.app/internal/marketplace-listings/q3> :white_check_mark:
Tom (sales): Quick question — do we want these tiers to be available on GCP marketplace too or AWS-only for Q3?
Ana (partnerships): Tentative AWS-only pilot. If metrics look good, roll to GCP in Q4.
Priya (rev-ops): I'll park a modeling variant for GCP but mark as TBD.
Marta (legal): ETA for addendum draft 48hrs.
Liam (finance): I'll post final numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Ana (partnerships): Great — thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 20m sync Friday to approve final wording. :calendar:
